description:
A flawless priest revered as God's perfect representative has always lived in a world of strict order and discipline. But his peaceful existence is disrupted when the empire's most beautiful noblewoman enters his life. With a personality as bright as sunshine, she begins to stir feelings he has never experienced before. 

Forced into an unwanted marriage, she defies her parents for the first time and flees to the grand temple to confess her sins. However, instead of offering her forgiveness, the priest declares that her body has already been tainted simply because another man dared to imagine touching her. Determined to cleanse her of this supposed impurity, he decides to absolve her sins by leaving his own mark upon her body, turning a sacred confession into something dangerously forbidden.
